name: LAMBADA
description: LAMBADA (LAnguage Modeling Broadened to Account for Discourse Aspects) is a benchmark requiring models to predict the final word of a passage. The key constraint is that humans can guess the final word when reading the full passage but cannot when given only the last sentence, ensuring the task requires broad discourse understanding rather than local context.
reputation: Classic benchmark for evaluating broad discourse understanding in language models; used as a standard evaluation in GPT series and many foundational LLM papers
notes: Introduced at ACL 2016. Dataset extracted from BookCorpus. Contains 10,022 test examples. Originally challenging (baseline models <1%), now largely saturated by modern LLMs. Still used as a sanity-check for language modeling capabilities in evaluation harnesses like lm-evaluation-harness.
